tasks.title: Fusion ablation
tasks.prompt: Diagnose a retrieval delta by comparing fusion behavior between baseline and candidate runs. Record changed rankings and representative queries.
tasks.acceptance_summary: Must tie fusion claims to changed per-query ranking behavior.
required_facts: Baseline and candidate fusion settings are named.
forbidden_claims: Fusion caused the delta without ranking evidence.

tasks.title: Stem fallback impact
tasks.prompt: Compare retrieval behavior with stem fallback enabled and disabled. Identify helped queries, hurt queries, and latency impact.
tasks.acceptance_summary: Must show query-level evidence for fallback impact.
required_facts: Helped and hurt queries are identified.
Latency impact is recorded if available.
forbidden_claims: Fallback hurts all queries without evidence.

tasks.title: Temporal failure bucket
tasks.prompt: Bucket temporal retrieval failures. Separate lexical miss, current/history confusion, as_of ambiguity, and ranking-order failures.
tasks.acceptance_summary: Must separate temporal failure types instead of treating them as one class.
forbidden_claims: All temporal failures have the same cause.

tasks.title: Candidate ordering
tasks.prompt: Compare candidate ordering for representative queries before and after a retrieval change. Report where the correct answer appears.
tasks.acceptance_summary: Must include rank evidence, not only aggregate recall.
required_facts: Before and after ranking are compared.
Top-k sensitivity is stated when relevant.
forbidden_claims: Recall changed for unknown ranking reasons.

tasks.title: Scenario validity
tasks.prompt: Audit a retrieval replay scenario whose delta is weak or zero. Decide whether the candidate behavior, benchmark scenario, or reporting threshold is the blocker.
tasks.acceptance_summary: Must check benchmark quality before recommending runtime changes.
required_facts: Pass/fail and delta computation are described.
Candidate and baseline decisions are compared.
Threshold/reporting blockers are named when relevant.
forbidden_claims: Need more data before checking scenario validity.
Delta=0 proves candidate has no value.
